user.title: Connect your Bluelink account
user.description: Use the same login as the Bluelink app. The region is where your account is registered (UK and Ireland: Europe).

data_description.pin: Your 4-digit Bluelink PIN. Required in Europe, and needed for remote commands in most other regions.

otp_method.title: Verify it's you
otp_method.description: Bluelink wants to confirm this new device. Choose where to send a one-time code.

otp_code.title: Enter code
otp_code.description: Enter the one-time code Bluelink just sent you.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Bluelink
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {username} stopped working. Enter the password again.

reconfigure.title: Update Bluelink login
reconfigure.description: Update the PIN for {username}. It's the 4-digit PIN you use for remote commands in the Bluelink app. Leave the password blank to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Bluelink servers, or they're having problems. Try again in a few minutes; the logs have details.
error.otp_send_failed: Bluelink could not send the code.
error.pin_required: Bluelink in Europe needs your PIN for remote commands.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the state cached in the Bluelink cloud. This does not wake the car.
data_description.force_refresh_interval: How old cached data may get before the car is woken up for fresh data. Each wake-up uses some 12V battery. 0 disables it.
data_description.climate_temperature: Target temperature for the Climate control, also set from its card. Use °F in the USA and °C elsewhere, including the UK.
data_description.quiet_start: No automatic polling from this time, so the car is never woken overnight. Commands still work. Set start and end to the same time to turn quiet hours off.
data_description.quiet_end: Automatic polling resumes at this time.
data_description.climate_max_temperature: The highest temperature your car's climate accepts, if it's lower than your region allows (for example 25 °C). Leave empty to allow the region's full range.
data_description.charging_refresh_interval: While the car is plugged in and charging, wake it this often to follow charging progress. A charging car is awake anyway. 0 turns it off. Quiet hours still apply.
data_description.min_12v_battery: The car is never woken automatically (force refresh or charging refresh) when its 12V battery is below this level.

error.invalid_temperature: Your region's API doesn't accept that temperature. Europe: 14-31.5 °C in 0.5 steps. USA: 62-81 °F.
error.above_max: The climate temperature is above the car's maximum.

start_climate.name: Start climate
start_climate.description: Start remote climate control with specific settings.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Cabin temperature: °F in the USA, °C elsewhere (Europe: 14-31.5 in 0.5 steps). Defaults to the integration option.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes to run. Defaults to the integration option.

climate.name: Climate
climate.description: Run the HVAC. Turn off to only use heaters.

heating.name: Heating
heating.description: Heated accessories: 0 off, 1 steering wheel and rear window, 2 rear window, 3 steering wheel, 4 all (region dependent).

front_left_seat.name: Front left seat
front_left_seat.description: Seat level as the region's API expects (often 0 off, 6-8 heat low-high, 3-5 cool low-high).

force_refresh.name: Force refresh
force_refresh.description: Wake the vehicle and fetch fresh data. Uses some 12V battery.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Vehicle to refresh. Leave empty for all vehicles.

set_charge_limits.name: Set charge limits
set_charge_limits.description: Set the AC and DC target state of charge.

dc_limit.name: DC limit
dc_limit.description: Target charge for DC fast charging (50-100%).

init.title: Enter your Bluelink PIN
init.description: Bluelink rejected the PIN saved for {account}, so remote commands won't work. Enter the 4-digit PIN you use for remote commands in the Bluelink app.

abort.entry_removed: This Bluelink account is no longer set up.

low_12v_battery.title: {vehicle}'s 12V battery is low
low_12v_battery.description: The 12V battery is at {level}%, below the {threshold}% you set, so Moolink has stopped waking the car automatically. Data still updates whenever the car reports in, and commands still work. Driving or charging the car recharges the 12V battery. This clears itself once the level recovers.

daily_limit_reached.title: Bluelink daily request limit reached
daily_limit_reached.description: Hyundai refused further requests today for {account}. Moolink has paused polling until midnight and keeps showing the last known state. Commands will also be refused until then. Consider a longer poll interval or quiet hours in the integration options.
